Posted by Richard Cowan October 20, 2005
See
 Steve Tuck Now Free and Getting Proper Medical Care. Will Return to Humboldt to Confront Medical Marijuana Cultivation Charges. The Many Issues In a Complex Case.

Steve Tuck is returning to Humboldt County this evening to deal with California charges for growing medical cannabis. He went to Federal Pretrial Services in San Francisco today, accompanied by NORML Legal Committee member Larry Lichter, who is a great guy. (He was not paid by MPP  or anyone else.)
See
 Medical Marijuana Patient, Steve Tuck, Denounces Marijuana Policy Project For Using His Name In Fund Raising Appeal. Tuck Must Report To Feds In SF Thursday.

However, Steve remains a hostage to the federal courts until they drop the charges for interstate flight to avoid prosecution  which they would in any normal case. Of course, Steve did not flee to avoid prosecution, but to avoid precisely what happened to him  being locked up without any medications, even those legally prescribed.

Inevitably, they want to urine test Steve to determine that he is not using medical cannabis  ( excuse me, smokedmarijuana). The problem is that Steve cannot urinate without whole cannabis  ( excuse me, smokedmarijuana).
See
 No Medicine Is Smoked. Okay, But Why Isnt Cannabis Sold Over-the-Counter? New MAPS/NORML Vaporizer Study Undermines Key Part Of Prohibitionist Party Line On Smoked-Marijuana.

Marinol does not work for this sort of problem.
See
 Marinol Was The First Schedule 2 Drug To Be "Down-Scheduled,"
Boasts Roxanne On Its New Marinol.com Web Site.
Doesnt That Mean That It Should Never Have Been Schedule 2 Anyway?
and links

Cannabinoids other than THC are required. Ironically, these cannabinoids are not illegal, but he will be jailed if the feds find them in his urine. This problem may sound familiar.
See
Government Claims Todd McCormick Failed "Drug" Test; Moves To Revoke Bail And Seize Woody Harrelsons Half Million

Ideally, he might be allowed to use Sativex, GWs whole cannabis product, but it has not been approved for use in the US, and that will take years.
See
 Program Notes for the MarijuanaNews World Report April 19, 2005 Sativex, Approved for Use In Canada. Proves Medical Value of Plant. Hires Prohibitionist Quack. Dangerous Pain Killers. Czar's Idiocy.

The Canadian catheter that he wore while being tortured in the Seattle jail had to be removed because of the resulting infections, for which the jail would not even provide antibiotics.

Consequently, the federal government is in the absurd position of insisting that the urinate to prove that he has not used cannabis, but he cannot do so without cannabis  unless he has a catheter that is extremely painful  among other things  and also threatens his life.
See
Steve Tuck Was Held In Whatcom County Jail WITHOUT MORPHINE! He Is In Agony! His Life Is In Danger.

His health has been badly damaged by the ordeal and he urgently needs medical attention, which is very expensive. When we all know more about his medical condition, Humboldt County will have to decide what to do.

Right now, Steves many friends need to be quiet, but ready.
